item.title: Setting Up a Playdate Dev Environment on Linux
item.description: I’ve been wanting to get back into gamedev for some time, and I think the key to doing this is to make some small games. A fun platform for this that I’ve been eyeing for some time is the Playdate. I don’t own one, as getting one shipped to Norway is surprisingly exxpensive, but do have access to one on occassion and I was hoping I could mostly get by with the simulator (which seems to mostly be true!). This article will go into the process of getting a decent developer environment set up, which I hope to follow up with updates on the gamedev process itself.
